description: This Java class defines a package-private final class 'JsonObjectMerger' implementing the BiFunction interface to merge two JSON objects recursively, favoring the first object in conflicts. It provides methods for deeply merging JSON objects and arrays, handling nulls, and ensuring proper combination of nested structures.

classes.name: JsonObjectMerger
classes.description: A package-private final class implementing recursive merging of two JsonObject instances, with conflict resolution favoring the first object.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Public method to merge two JsonObjects by delegating to mergeJsonObjects.

methods.name: mergeJsonObjects
methods.description: Private static method that performs the core recursive merging of two JsonObjects.

methods.name: mergeJsonValues
methods.description: Merges two JsonValues, handling nested objects and arrays recursively.

methods.name: areJsonObjects
methods.description: Checks whether both JsonValues are JsonObjects.

methods.name: areJsonArrays
methods.description: Checks whether both JsonValues are JsonArrays.

methods.name: mergeJsonArrays
methods.description: Recursively merges two JsonArrays by combining elements and handling different array sizes.

methods.name: getOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonValue at a specified index in a JsonArray, throwing an exception if absent.
